profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at PNC
profile.summary:
I'm a full stack Java developer with an interest in designing, implementing and maintaining SOA-based enterprise web applications. 

I started out refactoring legacy applications, steadily grokking the source and specs and shadowing established team members during the development cycle to understand 1) what the customer wants and 2) the fastest, cleanest way to get it to them. 

Now, I have experienced designing new features and fixes, writing (and revising) technical specs, and communicating with distributed agile teams and service partners to make feature releases happen--smoothly and surely.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design specifications and delegate sprint tasks to Scrum team to enable service partner for Event Notification web application.
• As SME for Alerts Business Accelerator for Payments team, trained team on ABA Admin Tool, enabling them to implement new alert types and customer messages to reduce time to UAT & QA deployment.
• Onboarding new team members (interns, employees) on existing application source/documentation and development tool setup.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Lead cross-functional, distributed team to enable new service module for Event Notification.
•	Improved testing time by developing tool for merging test data into customer message templates, reducing dependency on Test/QA environment uptime for validation.
•	Conducted knowledge transfer sessions for Alerts BA among team members.
•	Mentored Technology Development associates on Event Notification processes.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
•	Delivered features to Production within first year for customer facing web applications (Event Notification and Message Center) .
•	Appointed subject matter expert for Alerts BA and ILOG BRMS.
•	Collaborated to deliver web application utilized by customer service to assist with issues/tickets.

positions.title: Full-time CS Student
positions.description:
Burgeoning IT Generalist in the Tallahassee, FL area interested in opportunities for experience builders in the field of IT. 

Currently focused on software application development with skills utilizing C/C++ in the Microsoft Visual Studio 2010 IDE, Java in the Eclipse IDE.

positions.title: Summer Intern- Transformation IT
positions.description:
Leveraged Microsoft SharePoint to improve communication between divisions of IT.

Gained experience in project management through participating in vendor sessions and documentation revolving around a new business venture.

positions.title: Surveyor
positions.description: Conducted job vacancy study via telecommunications in order to create statistics that aided in reducing unemployment in the state of Florida through funding numerous job training facilities.
